description: A pair of black horns tipped in sickly green. Thornstag drops one every autumn and grows it back worse.
lore: Out east the year is not counted, it is picked up. [[monsters/corrupt_stag|Thornstag]] sheds one horn every autumn within a night or two of the same night, and a household on that road has been gathering them since before anyone there can date, one to a shelf, in order, the oldest by the door. Thirty-four gold apiece if they ever sold one. They never have, because the shelf is the only almanac that stretch of country has, and people will walk a day and a half to stand in the doorway and count back to the autumn they are trying to place.
Count the other way and you get the thing they do not walk there for. The green is climbing. On the ones by the door it is a fleck at the point. On this year's it is a third of the way up the horn.
gm_notes: The east's working calendar, and a measured trend nobody has decided what to do about. Useful if a season needs a date: count horns from the door.
